reason: Method is primarily options-based long volatility trading (calls/puts on indices/stocks) with trading around noise, not concrete long-side daily-bar rules for US stocks.

universe.description: Options on US equity indices (e.g. S&P) and stocks

setup.rule: Expect mean expansion / big directional change
setup.quote: volatility is mean expansion right so something is going to take off in in a direction

entry.rule: Buy calls for up capture or puts for down capture
entry.quote: if you if you're long vol and you want to be and you want to take advantage of the market going up you buy a call

stop.quote: all you could lose at the end of the day is your premium

exits.rule: Trade around noise while holding core long vol exposure
exits.quote: instead of buying and holding this call for a month i'm gonna do i believe that i can you know the market's going to be a bit down over the next few days let's say as a swing trader i'd say okay it sell it looks a bit toppy here so it's going to pull pull in so i'm going to sell some of the calls i have
